item.title: Clearlake man found guilty in Mendocino County child sex abuse case
item.description: Christopher Neil Kiger fled to Florida and arrested after returning to Mendocino County in 2024, officials said. A jury convicted him Friday, March 6, 2026 of child sex abuse that occurred between October 4, 2020 and June 16, 2023, prosecutors said.
